items.name: Pipeline Keystone Badge
items.blurb: Forged for master builders who anchor robust distributed pipelines and turn chaotic data flow into foundational infrastructure.

items.name: The Shielded Hermit’s ACID View Shadow Puppet
items.blurb: This articulated shadow puppet honors the resilient data views of this palace, featuring a hermit crab sheltered by a protective transactional shield to ensure the ACID properties remain unbroken.

items.name: Seal of PySpark SQL Operations
items.blurb: An intricate, giant wax-seal impression symbolizing the ultimate query orchestrations and DataFrame transformations within the hall.

items.name: API to Power BI Clay Conduit
items.blurb: This hand-built clay trophy celebrates the bridge between web APIs and Power BI, guarded by a curious bower-bird and a Bone marmoset.

items.name: Windowed Rank & Aggregation Obelisk
items.blurb: Carved from dark veined marble, its segmented pillars and ascending ladder embody partitioned rows, ordered rankings, and grouped Spark aggregations.

items.name: Delta Chronometer Origami
items.blurb: This folded geometric hourglass represents Delta Lake Time Travel by capturing historical table states across exact timestamps and version logs.

items.name: Delta Table Restoration Ledger
items.blurb: This cast bronze miniature honors the mastery of rolling back data blocks through versioned history while keeping operations safe from accidental overwrites or vacuum erasure.

items.name: Tiered Medallion Crown
items.blurb: This tiered relic of bronze, silver, and gold honors the journey of raw data refined into pure reporting truth.

items.name: The Delta Balance Prism
items.blurb: A hand-blown cobalt and amber glass scale weighing the structured treasure of managed data against the open expanse of external, location-based storage under an inspecting gaze.

items.name: Duck's External Table Drop
items.blurb: The warrior duck removes external metadata while keeping internal files safe.

items.name: Semantic Layout Engine
items.blurb: A tin-toy semantic engine turns structured meaning into F-Pattern, Z-Pattern, and Gestalt layouts, embodying how semantic layers organize data for effective visual presentation.

items.name: Lakeflow Orchestration Crest
items.blurb: This enamel badge honors mastery over automated data pipelines, dynamic control routing, and linked task workflows in Lakeflow Jobs.
